name: ARIA
description: ARIA: an 8-voice, bi-timbral analogue-modelling polysynth. Two oscillators with a continuous wave mix, FM and sync, a per-voice mod oscillator, a saturating mixer, two transistor-ladder filters in series, stereo or parallel, looping envelopes, a chord memory with a chord on every key, an arpeggiator with a 16-step pattern on the MPC's grid, and a diffusion delay. The same engine as the ARIA VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
